nodes.name: ClubSpark Package Import Queue Form Webhook

parameters.query:
WITH latest_numeric_season AS (
  SELECT max(season::int)::text AS season
  FROM public.membership_packages
  WHERE season ~ '^[0-9]{4}$'
), target_packages AS (
  SELECT json_agg(
    json_build_object(
      'name', mp.name,
      'category', mp.category,
      'season', mp.season
    )
    ORDER BY mp.display_order NULLS LAST, mp.name
  ) AS packages
  FROM public.membership_packages mp
  CROSS JOIN latest_numeric_season ls
  WHERE (
      ls.season IS NOT NULL
      AND mp.season = ls.season
    )
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(mp.category), ''), '') <> 'Pavilion Key'
), current_batch AS (
  SELECT b.id AS batch_id
  FROM public.signup_batches b
  WHERE b.status = 'Processing'
  ORDER BY b.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN gs.key = 'n8n_base_url' THEN gs.value END) AS n8n_base_url,
  COALESCE((SELECT batch_id FROM current_batch), NULL) AS current_batch_id,
  COALESCE((SELECT packages FROM target_packages), '[]'::json) AS target_packages
FROM public.global_settings gs
WHERE gs.key = 'n8n_base_url';
